title: ConfFlow workflow V3 (DRAFT — design only)
$comment: DRAFT ONLY. Not used by the runtime, not part of any package data, and NOT referenced by workflow_schema_sha256 or the configuration contract. See docs/rfc/WORKFLOW_V3_RFC.md. This schema describes the DOCUMENT (runnable) profile: a step requires `id`. A recipe FRAGMENT profile (id optional) is a separate, looser profile that R3.2 publishes; a fragment that carries an id must still satisfy `$defs/id`. R3.2 replaces all of this with a production schema.

extensions.description: Semantic, namespaced producer data. Participates in the definition fingerprint. A namespace the producer does not recognise is a runnable ERROR (RFC §6.3).

annotations.description: Non-semantic presentation data (GUI layout, comments). Never fingerprinted.

id.description: Workflow-local, immutable step identity. Lowercase only. Legal grammar is permissive; the allocator generates only two shapes: sequential `^s[0-9]{3,}$` (V2 upgrade) and opaque `^s_[a-z2-7]{8}$` (application adds), per RFC §5.3/§5.4.

from_step.description: Id of an upstream calc step whose checkpoint file is reused (RFC §11).

paramsDraft.$comment: DRAFT PLACEHOLDER ONLY — this is NOT the V3 policy. The production V3 schema (R3.2) enumerates the core parameters per step type and sets additionalProperties:false: an unknown core `params` member is a DEFINITION ERROR (RFC §6.4), because a misspelled semantic parameter must never run silently. This placeholder only asserts `params` is an object so the design examples can be checked before R3.2 authors the typed enum.

label.description: Human-facing title. May duplicate; never an identity.

type.description: Canonical step type. Legacy aliases task/gen are V2-adapter only.

enabled.description: When false, the step is a pass-through bypass (RFC §12).

inputs.description: Geometry/data-flow predecessors. Empty array = consumes the workflow input (root).
